listing.title: Tree Farm Season Shirt, Watercolor Red Truck Christmas Tree Tee, Vintage Truck Holiday Shirt, Farmhouse Christmas Gift for Her
listing.description: A vintage red stepside pickup, painted in layered watercolor, carries a fresh-cut tree wrapped in tiny string lights and a red bow. Snow rests on the cab, the hood and the branches of the spruces on either side, a misty pine forest fades into the distance and snow is falling, with a little wreath on the truck door. "Tree Farm" is painted in red brush script with "SEASON" in green between two holly sprigs, and "fresh cut & headed home" in green script below. For anyone whose holidays start with picking out the tree.
